sales_notes:
Top-line: Government agency-level prospect. Mission: operator-facing assistant + classified document summarization and SOP retrieval inside an isolated on-prem enclave. Strong aversion to any egress or third-party telemetry.

Recent activity (shorthand):
- 2025-10-08: Intro call (AE Jordan) — interest in private deployment, asked for high-level architecture.
- 2025-11-15: NDA executed (legal).
- 2026-01-12: Security intake submitted (12p questionnaire).
- 2026-02-18: Tech deep-dive w/ infra + security (recorded FF-2026-02-18-8432).
- 2026-03-02: On-prem scoping w/ infra lead — asked for BOM + network topology.
- 2026-03-09: Requested air-gap POC image and install runbook; SE to deliver initial build.

Use-case details / requirements (customer language and notes):
- Primary workloads: operator chat (short-turn Q/A), incident summarization (hourly batch), SOP search and redaction of classified content.
- Latency: p95 interactive < 500ms for 512-token context where possible; burst to support 10 concurrent operator sessions.
- Throughput: non-critical embedding/rerank batch jobs ~20k docs/day (offline).
- Models: preference for vetted open models (quantized variants) or Redwood-verified smaller footprints. No external model hosting.
- Availability: 99.9% SLA desired for operator tools; tolerance for longer windows during maintenance with manual failover.

Security / compliance specifics called out by customer:
- Must run in air-gapped enclave; no outbound connections allowed without manual change control.
- Integration with central AD/PIV/CAC for operator auth, SSO/SAML for admin flows.
- HSM-backed keys (on-prem) and full audit logging sent to Splunk instance inside the enclave.
- Evidence requirements: NIST 800-53 mapping, DISA STIG checklist references, support for ATO package (customer will maintain accreditation timeline).
- Data handling: strict retention controls, on-demand purge, attestable chain-of-custody for training telemetry (they will not permit sharing).

POC plan discussed:
- Phase 0: security Q + full questionnaire (done).
- Phase 1: air-gap installer image + runbook deployed in customer lab (2 rack units reserved). Need hardware BOM approval.
- Phase 2: small-scale inference test w/ seeded prompts and metric collection (latency/cost/trace).
- Phase 3: ops/patching runbook handover and planning for ATO artifacts (evidence pack).

Customer quotes / verbal notes:
- "Cannot have any external model access or telemetry — must be entirely self-contained."
- "We need a demonstrable chain of custody for any data used during the POC."
- Security lead: "We will require STIG hardening and a vendor-provided hardening checklist to attach to ATO."

Open questions / risks:
- Hardware: customer currently evaluating H100 vs A100 racks; need final BOM and procurement lead time (4–6 weeks).
- Accreditation: ATO window likely 6–9 months — procurement and legal are cautious.
- Licensing: pricing for air-gapped private install + support retention unknown; finance needs a clear ARR model for procurement.
- Escalation path for critical patches inside an air-gap (manual media swap) still TBD.

Next actions (short):
- SE (Priya) to deliver air-gap installer image + install runbook by 2026-03-15.
- Schedule on-site enclave readiness visit with infra team (AE + SE) for week of 2026-03-28.
- Draft ATO evidence map and hand to security lead for review.
- Provide hardware BOM options (H100 / A100) with cost delta and expected throughput.

CRM tone: terse, lots of named stakeholders. Keep close cadence; this is high priority for program office.
